{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor-coil heaters''' were components used on [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] had to add additional [[Repulsor coil/Legends|repulsor-coil]] heaters to the snowspeeders to adapt them to the cold environment of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The heaters were used to keep the vehicle's motors from freezing.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
